label: TP
reason: Assessed alert java/xss: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest00642') flows through SeparateClassRequest.getTheParameter() into param, then into valuesList. Although 'safe' is added first and removed at line 56, this shifts the array indices so valuesList.get(0) at line 57 retrieves the user-provided param (now at index 0). The resulting bar string is printed via toCharArray() to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding, allowing user-controlled data to reach the HTML sink. This is a genuine XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User param flows through ArrayList manipulation (add/remove/get) to bar, which is written to response without encoding
